name: liamtra/tts-phpmailer-deps
description: PHPMailer for the Travellers-Flight-Api-Platform front app (app/). Installs straight into vendor/phpmailer so Common_helper.php's require 'vendor/phpmailer/autoload.php' keeps working unchanged. Was previously committed pre-built at vendor/phpmailer on phpmailer/phpmailer 6.1.4, which has known security advisories - upgraded here to a patched 6.x release.
